<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/subscriptions/{sub}/commitment"}
#docs
The commitment segments of the current term, the commitment owed for the whole term, the fees counted toward it so far (recurring, plan-change and usage fees before discounts and tax, less plan-change and cancellation credit notes) and the shortfall the term-end true-up would bill now.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `sub` | `string` | **yes** | Subscription id (sub_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | The amount in minor units (integer), e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |
| `currency` | `string` | The commitment's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `segments` | `array of object` | The segments. |
| `prorated_minor` | `integer` | The prorated in minor units (integer), e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |
| `counted_minor` | `integer` | The counted in minor units (integer), e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |
| `shortfall_minor` | `integer` | The shortfall in minor units (integer), e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |
| `term` | `object` | The term. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | commitment |
| `404` | No such subscription |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/subscriptions/sub_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/commitment" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
